motivation: R1.2 passed one of two public NIST observed data targets; R1.3 tests new instruments and stronger non-symbolic baselines without retroactive tuning.

data_handling.splitting: Sort distinct raw x ascending and assign group ordinal modulo 5: 0 TEST, 1 VALIDATION, 2/3/4 TRAIN; equal-x replicates always in same group
data_handling.normalization: z=(x-min_x)/(max_x-min_x); min/max determined from published instrument domain without y; no use of TEST labels for normalization
data_handling.response: raw measured y; no normalization except within models
data_handling.negative_controls: For each dataset, keep train intact and cyclically shift validation labels by floor(n_val/2). These controls require ABSTAIN; a discovered law is a protocol failure.
data_handling.ground_truth_scope: Public original measurements with published certified nonlinear forms; not secret or unknown physics.

candidate_algorithm.source: Frozen JANUS-LOGOS-001 R1.2 r12_discover.py, no grid, grammar or threshold retuning; only wrapper translates new train/validation cases to R1.2 per-case API
candidate_algorithm.frozen_model_families: poly 0..4, Gaussian center-grid, exponential decay rates, rational-exponential
candidate_algorithm.inner_selection: train-only 3fold grouped CV on distinct normalized x
candidate_algorithm.outer_selection: validation normalized RMSE plus 0.008 * parameter count
candidate_algorithm.proposal_gate: candidate VAL RMSE < 0.98 * VAL best simple poly degree0..3; otherwise ABSTAIN
candidate_algorithm.learning_bottleneck: No model retrieval from public NIST certified formula and no TEST labels within discoverer process

families: POLY0..5 OLS with deterministic numpy.linalg.lstsq (no regularization)
RIDGE_POLY_DEGREE_5 alpha=0.01 after scaling feature powers
PCHIP shape-preserving cubic interpolation on unique-x means (SciPy)
SMOOTHING_SPLINE UnivariateSpline s=n*(sd_train_y*{0.01,0.1,1.0})**2 (SciPy), using group-averaged unique x
RANDOM_FOREST RF 300 trees min_samples_leaf in {1,3,5} fixed random_state 1301 and n_jobs=1
KERNEL_RIDGE RBF gamma in {0.5,2,8,32} alpha in {0.001,0.1,1.0} with numpy/scikit-learn
external_baseline_suite.selection: Evaluate all frozen baseline parameter configurations on VALIDATION, select minimum RMSE; lexicographic tie break; DO NOT SELECT AGAIN BASED ON TEST
external_baseline_suite.safety: Potential numeric ill-conditioning or invalid models excluded with explicit diagnostic; no silent changes in family list

statistical_evaluation.independent_witness: Second GitHub Actions worker checks exact source Git blob sha and independently reconstructs split and TEST scores. No witness import from candidate wrapper.
statistical_evaluation.metric: Paired test RMSE, relative gain=1-rmse_candidate/rmse_strong_baseline; all rows, including abstentions and failures, preserved
statistical_evaluation.bootstrap: Paired cluster bootstrap by distinct TEST x; deterministic random.Random(1301); B=2000; percentile 2.5%,97.5% of relative gain computed from squared error arrays; report bootstrap CI as descriptive conditional on fixed trained models.
statistical_evaluation.multiple_testing: Three independent observed datasets, Holm-Bonferroni across 3 one-sided paired bootstrap p-values if nominal hypothesis tests used; main gate uses 95% CI plus 5% point threshold for all three as conservative exploratory threshold, not formal proof.
statistical_evaluation.pre_frozen_success_gate: Three of three datasets PROPOSE, >=5% TEST RMSE gain vs validation-selected strong baseline AND lower paired group bootstrap 95% CI >0 for each. Otherwise NOT_COMPETITIVE; no model promotion in any outcome.
statistical_evaluation.uncertainty_limits: Bootstrap with 8 independent test x on Thurber has low power and does not establish external reproducibility.

versioning: Preregistration frozen before first new holdout evaluation; inspect only NIST metadata, n, x range and duplicate counts beforehand; no TEST response analyses or model fits.
next_gate: R1.4 external sealed holdout data owned by independent evaluator, then cross-domain transfer with explanatory falsifiers.
